era: Merged with North Huntingdon into Norwin (blue and gold) in 1958.

notes: Identity doubt: picked the Apollo (Westmoreland, WPIAL) school; the other e-yearbook Washington Township HS (Waynesboro, Franklin Co.) used maroon and gray but is not District 7. Colours fairly consistent for Apollo school; low only because identity is unconfirmed.

School paper also called Crimson and White.
